fixes.new:
An ultra-dreadnought-class Space Daigan boasting a size nearly equal to the Moon.
It was originally 'Cathedral Terra,' the flagship of the Spiral Tribe led by $$ロージェノム$$, but $$シモン$$ renamed it, and it became Team Dai-Gurren's base of operations in space.
It is so enormous that it cannot descend to Earth, and even moving within the ship is difficult without using warp gates.
It possesses a variety of functions beyond imagination, including not only the ability to travel across space-time, but also a hyperdimensional anchor capable of interfering with imaginary space, and a Spiral World Recognition Transfer System capable of instantly moving to any location it has ever perceived.
fixes.reason: Japanese says スペースダイガン (Space Daigan, as in R-Daigan), not スペースガンメン; the English named the wrong class of machine.

fixes.new:
A transcendent-spiral, super-dreadnought Gunmen transformed from $$超銀河ダイグレン$$.
Its core block is the fully drillized Arc-$$グレンラガン$$.
$$シモン$$'s Spiral Power activates $$グレンラガン$$, $$グレンラガン$$'s drill gives birth to Arc-$$グレンラガン$$, and the energy from Arc-$$グレンラガン$$'s Super Spiral Engine drives $$超銀河グレンラガン$$ -- making it the strongest Gunmen in the universe, one that could be called the very symbol of Spiral Power.
The giant drills on both shoulders are launched and merge into a single super-giant Giga Drill, unleashing the finishing move, the Super Galaxy Giga Drill Break.
fixes.reason: 宇宙最強 is stated flatly; とも言うべき ('one might call') belongs to 螺旋力の象徴, not to 'strongest'. 'in a sense' wrongly hedged the strongest claim.

fixes.new:
The $$汎用ヒト型決戦兵器　人造人間エヴァンゲリオン　試験初号機$$.
The EVA series is humanity's only weapon capable of opposing the Angels, and $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ branches around the world are pouring vast sums of money into its development and construction.
Its greatest characteristic is its ability to deploy an A.T. Field. 'A.T.' stands for 'Absolute Terror,' referring to the absolutely inviolable territory the Angels deploy. By having the same ability, an EVA can erode its opponent's field, making it possible for the first time to attack the core and other targets.
Its main power is electricity supplied through the umbilical cable on its back. If the cable is severed, it switches to its internal power source, but reaches its activity limit within five minutes.
Unit-01's main armaments include the Progressive Knife for close combat, a large-caliber 209mm rifle, and a portable rotary multi-barrel 440mm cannon.
In the battle against $$第９の使徒$$, by switching control over to the Dummy System, it fought with overwhelming power beyond its usual output and thoroughly destroyed $$ＥＶＡ３号機$$, which had become $$第９の使徒$$.
fixes.reason: 絶対不可侵領域: 不可侵 (inviolable) was dropped; コアなど is 'the core and other (targets)', 'weak points' is an addition. Same wording as robot 259 fixed by its translator.

fixes.new:
The General-Purpose Humanoid Decisive Battle Weapon, Artificial Human Evangelion, Production Model Unit-02.
Its assigned pilot is $$式波・アスカ・ラングレー$$. Its main color is red.
Unlike Unit-00 and Unit-01, which were a prototype and a test type from the development process, it is the world's first official production type built for actual combat. $$アスカ$$ calls it 'a real Evangelion'.
Its main armaments include the Progressive Knife for close combat and the super-electromagnetic bow gun, among others. It also has S-type equipment used when dropping from a transport aircraft.
When $$第７の使徒$$ appeared, it made its entrance by dropping from a transport aircraft, and annihilated the Angel with the acrobatic tactic of kicking an arrow through its core.
Note that after its pilot $$アスカ$$ withdrew from the front lines, $$真希波・マリ・イラストリアス$$ boarded it and fought $$第１０の使徒$$.
fixes.reason: The token English already begins with 'the' ('the Tenth Angel'), so the extra article gave 'the the Tenth Angel'.

fixes.new:
$$ゼロ$$'s personal KMF.
Equipped with a variable mechanism, it can transform into Fortress Mode, and is capable not only of high-speed flight but also underwater travel.
Though it is derived from a unit made for the $$黒の騎士団$$, repurposing $$ガウェイン$$'s Druid System gives it remarkable processing power. To make optimal use of Absolute Defense Field, the powerful defensive field said to offer the best protection in the world, its surroundings must be fed into the Druid System instantly and accurately.
Its chest is also equipped with a diffusion-structure phase-transition cannon: it fires solid liquid metal, then irradiates that metal with a particle beam, and the liquid metal diffuses the particles.
Making full use of these two distinctive offensive and defensive systems requires a level of information processing ability high enough to draw out the full power of the Druid System. For this reason, it is said that even if anyone other than $$ルルーシュ$$ can pilot it, they cannot bring out its full performance.
Perhaps because a touch-panel keyboard is used for its calculations, the cockpit interior is not the motorcycle-style type designed by $$ラクシャータ$$, but closer to the $$ブリタニア$$-line designs such as $$ガウェイン$$'s.
It was also designed with long-distance travel in mind, so its cockpit is roomier than that of other KMFs, and can even store things like Zero's mask and costume.
When Zero was pursued by the $$黒の騎士団$$, $$ロロ$$ stole it to use for their escape, and it remained $$ルルーシュ$$'s mount to the very end, even when he rode it as Emperor of $$ブリタニア$$.
In the final battle, it sortied equipped with the $$フレイヤ・エリミネーター$$ to stop a $$フレイヤ$$ detonation. Within the 19 seconds before the explosion, $$ルルーシュ$$ input environmental data, and together with $$スザク$$, succeeded in stopping the $$フレイヤ$$.
In the end, it was destroyed inside $$ダモクレス$$ by $$ジノ$$'s $$トリスタン・ディバイダー$$.
fixes.reason: (1) 液体金属が粒子を拡散させる: it is the liquid metal that diffuses the particles; 'across a wide area' was an addition and the actor was lost. (2) 環境データを打ち込み has no subject; a machine cannot input data, and the entry settles the pilot as Lelouch ('remained Lelouch's mount to the very end').
